svg.aria-label: A 20-second demo: porch share --e2e seals a photo and prints a link on your domain; a friend opens it and it decrypts in their browser; an hour later the door has closed and they ask to reopen; you tap Allow 1h on your lock screen and their page comes back.

text.tspan: · the box holds ciphertext; the key is in the link

svg.text: Sealed on your box, served on your own domain.

g.text: Sealed on your box, served on your own domain.

svg.text: Decrypted in their browser. The key never reaches the server.

g.text: Decrypted in their browser. The key never reaches the server.

svg.text: An hour later, the door is closed
The porch light is off. They tap Ask to reopen.

g.text: An hour later, the door is closed
The porch light is off. They tap Ask to reopen.

svg.text: You answer from your lock screen
Allow 1h, and their page comes back by itself.

svg.text: All on your own domain. No account, no cloud, one box.
